package.name: aav_mppi_lag
package.description: mppi_lag in Rust (rclrs): Nav2's MPPI path follower, ported, on a car model that knows the actuators' lag (the steering motor's rate and linkage, the throttle and brake, their dead times, the spine's speed loop and ego's ramps). A trial beside Nav2's MPPI (navigation.launch.py tracker:=mppi_lag): it serves follow_path in controller_server's place and publishes cmd_vel_nav. Says /drivers/nav/lag_aware (latched) so ego's lead stays off.
